selection_contract: Download and retain the exact source bytes, access timestamp, source URL, license text, and sha256 before selecting records.

Filter only by source fields: active status, dense-city boundary, allowed POI family, non-empty official name, stable source record ID, and valid coordinates. Never query a compared provider during selection.
Within each source and family, sort eligible records by sha256(source_plan_id + NUL + source_record_id) and review in that order until the quota is filled.

Reject tourist icons, generic unnamed facilities, duplicate branches, records whose official status cannot be confirmed, and records whose source coordinate is visibly an administrative centroid. Retain every rejection and reason.
For projected coordinates, retain the original values, source CRS, transformation command and version, and transformed WGS84 values.
Freeze the 200 cases and their case-file sha256 before the first Overture, Nominatim, or Photon request.
Do not geocode a source address with Overture, Nominatim, Photon, Google, or another compared or closed provider to manufacture gold coordinates.
If any source is found to be OSM-derived, mark osm_derived=true and make its cases Overture-only before measurement.
